entries.heading: None of the funds made available by this Act may be used
ancestors: DIVISION J—MILITARY CONSTRUCTION, VETERANS AFFAIRS, AND RELATED AGENCIES APPROPRIATIONS ACT, 2018
entries.text:
Sec. 257.  None of the funds made available by this Act may be used 
to charge a veteran a fee for a veterans identification card pursuant to 
section 5706(c) of title 38, United States Code.
